newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends sharply up, over resistance.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends sharply up, over resistance.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures pierced resistance at 10.86 cents shortly after midday and continued to rack up gains fueled by mostly speculative buying in March, floor sources said.
The trade was cited as a steady buyer of the May/July spread, which closed even with Friday's close at 0.04 cent.
Dealers pegged the next overhead target at 11.00 cents in March, adding that follow-through buying on Wednesday was likely amid brisk volume estimated at 33,625 lots today.
Producer scale-up selling will provide point-by-point resistance over 10.90 cents, however.
"We may flirt with 11.00 cents but for the most part it's a bit overdone," a broker said. "I think a 20-point pullback would be fair."
Support was seen around 10.77 in March and at 10.69 in May.
The spot-March contract settled up 0.14 to 10.92 cents, having ranged from 10.92 to 10.76 cents. Buying was also brisk in the second-position May contract, which finished 0.14 higher at 10.88.
The deferred contracts went out 0.09 to 0.05 firmer.
Open interest in the spot month remains high at 42,797 lots, down 1,127 lots from Friday's close. Open interest in May stood at 40,954 lots, down 1,017 lots.
Rumors of cargoes trading out of the Far East over the weekend provided some fundamental support, market sources said, but there was no confirmation of any activity.
